clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon brews an experimental draught for the Royal Apothecary Society. Its work aims to create a virulent plague against living humans and the Scourge.

Apothecary Lydon gathers raw reagents from the wilderness around ruined Tarren Mill and combines them into toxic draughts. The work follows the Royal Apothecary Society's overarching mandate to formulate a new plague that will exterminate the living and the dead alike. To test the brew's potency, Lydon gives it to his assistant, a frog named Umpi.
